Completed E1-R1 prototype updates:

- Revised apertures and added detached forward calorimeter.
- Added full/partial/missed axial-allocation diagnostics.
- Regenerated report and r–z figures with forward detail.
- Added validation catalogue, including MU-V01–08 and mandatory later field propagation.
- Preserved previous proposal revision in metadata.

**Checks:** 11 tests passed; 10 allocations, 21 sampled rays, zero rectangle overlaps; 23 session records valid.

At η=4, the forward allocation is traversed fully; ECal endcap is missed and HCal endcap only partially traversed. Forward allocation also spans η=5 and 5.2 geometrically. These are allocation findings, not containment or performance results.

No commits or production geometry changes.
